previous-period totals for trend comparison.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Cloudflare account identifier.

name
props.description:
Specifies the column name to filter on. Requires a valid column for the target

props.name: op
props.description:
Filter operator. Common values: `eq`, `neq`, `in`, `not_in`, `gt`, `lt`, `gte`,

props.name: values
props.description: Values to match against. Type depends on the column.
Filters to apply before aggregating results.

props.name: from
props.description:
The start of the query time range (inclusive). RFC3339 format with

props.name: groupBy
props.description:
Specifies the column names to group results by. Requires valid
columns for the target dataset.

props.name: stats
props.description:
Specifies the stat names to include in results. Requires valid stats
for the target dataset (e.g. `attemptsTotal`, `bytesTotal`).

props.name: to
props.description:
Specifies the end of the query time range (exclusive). Requires
RFC3339 format with timezone.

methods.name: timeseries
methods.summary: Returns time-bucketed analytics data for a dataset.
methods.description:
Returns time-bucketed analytics data for a dataset. Includes time slots, each
containing the requested stats, group-by dimensions, and resolution-controlled
bucket size (e.g. `hour`, `day`).
